changes.what: Loops run on local copies of coefficients, state and jcong, written back after the block
changes.whyExact: The output buffers are render buffers and never alias a filter or jcong. Nothing is called inside the loops. The arithmetic is unchanged.

changes.what: Invariant branches taken once per block (LP saturation, HP AA/tanh/none, SVF mix)
changes.whyExact: They depend only on the configuration. With sampleIncrement != 1 the branch stays per sample, as before.

changes.what: Morph 0 cases: LP morph term dropped, HP temp_fc = max(fc, limit); SVF terms with a zero coefficient skipped
hpfLastWorkingValue written only at block end when not antialiasing
changes.whyExact: In those modes nothing reads it during the block, so only the last value survives

changes.what: smmlar feedback chains, smmla for noisy_m
Stereo: one pass per channel; LP noise stepped by the 2-step LCG, left pass starts from the modular inverse
changes.where: all three (oversampled drive keeps its joint loop)
changes.whyExact: The channels are independent. The LCG jump is exact mod 2^32 and checked by static_assert. The final jcong is unchanged.

changes.what: Unit-stride specialisation; NEON add for parallel routing
changes.whyExact: Same loop. vaddq wraps like add, and the two buffers never overlap.

randomized: 2048 cases × 64 blocks: random modes switched between blocks (including OFF, so resets and fades run), routing, parameters that drift or jump, cpuDireness (oversampling), input (noise, saw, silence, full scale), 1-128 frames per block (odd ones included), mono with stride 1/2/3, and stereo. The hash covers the output, jcong and the FilterSet bytes. gcov: everything covered except the oversampled NONE loop, which setConfig cannot reach.
dropped: L/R in NEON lanes (rounds differently). Precomputing noisy_m in a separate pass (about 2 instr/sample net). Hand-written asm loop. Changes to the tanh table lookup (shared function).

changes.what: Interpolation weights by NEON from a phase vector (<<tsm, vshrn #16), table reads with vld2.16, no {0} inits, applyAmplitude outside the loop
changes.saving: Table path −28 to −30%, 42→29 instructions per 4 samples
changes.whyExact: A left shift is linear modulo 2^32, so the same bits 16..31 as phase>>(16−tsm) (tsm≤13). vld2 reads the same two int16 as the 32-bit lane load. The arithmetic stays unchanged.

changes.what: Crude saw and square (<72 Hz) and triangle (<711 Hz) with 4 lanes
changes.whyExact: smmlar = bits 32..63 of (sum<<32)+a·b+2^31 = vmull+vrshrn#32+vadd mod 2^32. Triangle = min(p,−p)−2^30, square = INT32_MAX xor mask. The remainder (numSamples&3) runs first as scalar code, phases and amplitudes unsigned mod 2^32.

changes.what: Divisions in sync and PW via vdiv.f64
changes.where: render_wave.h (RENDER_OSC_SYNC), voice.cpp (sync setup, analog square PW)
changes.whyExact: The correctly rounded double division, truncated, gives the integer quotient (32-bit operands). At 64 bits the result is q or q+1, and a remainder correction compensates. Special cases (divisor 0, phase in the next cycle) go through the old code.

bench: 17 fixed and 30,000 random cases: all 18 hashes ARM old = new. 800k divisions, 0 wrong. Inserted bugs (mutations) are detected. Instructions: saw 1578→1112, triangle 1662→606, analog square PW 2569→1416.
